editorialRepairs.before: Magistrate Wang Bing of Xiangping and general Sun Ji turned Liaodong against him, while Feng Chou, Yi Yi, Han Jiao, Gao Xu, and others abandoned their posts and fled.
editorialRepairs.after: Xiangping magistrate Wang Bing and general Sun Ji rebelled in Liaodong against Huang; Eastern Yi Colonel Feng Chou, Protector Yi Yi, Liaodong chancellor Han Jiao, Xuantu prefect Gao Xu, and others abandoned their cities and fled back.
editorialRepairs.sourceQuote: 襄平令王冰、將軍孫機以遼東叛於皝，東夷校尉封抽、護軍乙逸、遼東相韓矯、玄菟太守高詡等棄城奔還。
editorialRepairs.sourceBasedReason: The idiomatic English omits the offices 東夷校尉/護軍/遼東相/玄菟太守 and softens 棄城奔還 to abandoned posts; titles identify 封抽 for this case. Paired literal already keeps the offices.
editorialRepairs.pairedFieldChecked: Xiangping magistrate Wang Bing and general Sun Ji rebelled in Liaodong against Huang; Eastern Yi Colonel Feng Chou, protector Yi Yi, Liaodong chancellor Han Jiao, Xuantu prefect Gao Xu, and others abandoned cities and fled back.

editorialRepairs.before: Soon afterward Yuwen Qidegui was driven out by a rival kinsman, Yidougui, and died in exile; Huang led cavalry against Yidougui, who sued for peace; Huang then built Yuyin and Anjin and withdrew.
editorialRepairs.after: Soon afterward Yuwen Qidegui was driven out by his separate-division leader Yidougui and died in exile; Huang led cavalry against Yidougui, who sued for peace; Huang then built Yuyin and Anjin and withdrew.
editorialRepairs.sourceQuote: 尋而宇文乞得龜為其別部逸豆歸所逐，奔死於外，皝率騎討之，逸豆歸懼而請和，遂築榆陰、安晉二城而還。
editorialRepairs.sourceBasedReason: 別部 is a separate division, not a ‘rival kinsman’; the paired literal already reads separate division.
editorialRepairs.pairedFieldChecked: Soon Yuwen Qidegui was by his separate division Yidougui expelled, fled and died outside; Huang led cavalry to campaign against him; Yidougui feared and requested peace; thereupon built the two cities of Yuyin and Anjin and returned.

editorialRepairs.before: Recently you have deeply fulfilled the hope of a happy land; the people of China will all bring food to welcome you; with Shi Hu, who can compare!
editorialRepairs.after: Recently you have deeply fulfilled the hope of a happy land; the people of China will all bring food to welcome you; Shi Jilong—who will dwell with him!
editorialRepairs.sourceQuote: 邇者深副樂土之望，中國之人皆將壺餐奉迎，石季龍誰與居乎！
editorialRepairs.sourceBasedReason: 誰與居乎 means who will dwell/remain with him, not ‘who can compare’. Paired idiomatic English already has the remain sense.
editorialRepairs.pairedFieldChecked: Recently you have deeply fulfilled the hope of a happy land; the people of China will all bring food to welcome you. Who then will remain with Shi Hu?
